 PM congratulates Tejalben Damor on winning Silver at the Asian Para Games 
 22 Oct, 2026 
 Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Tejalben Damor for her excellent performance and winning the Silver in the Women’s 400m T12 event at the Asian Para Games 2026.
 Shri Modi stated that her speed, determination, and commitment to excellence are truly commendable, and extended his congratulations on this achievement.
 In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office shared:
 “Another excellent performance by Tejalben Damor!
 She has won the Silver in the Women’s 400m T12 event at the Asian Para Games 2026.
 Her speed, determination and commitment to excellence are truly commendable.
 Congratulations to Tejalben on this achievement: PM @narendramodi”
